remarks: Fredonia 4 bedroom with nice comfortable layout! This home is located on a quiet side street that many do not know even exists! Tucked away yet walking distance to Village parks and restaurants! Let's tour this beauty! First floor features 2 bedrooms and a full bath with walk-in shower, along with a dining room, living room and a sundrenched bright and airy kitchen! Upstairs has another 2 bedrooms, another full bathroom and several closets for storage. Welcoming kitchen has Corian solid surface countertops, great prep space for cooking and great amount of cupboard and cabinet storage. Such a handy basement as well that has a laundry area plus mechanical area and workshop area which adds storage plus useful workspace. Vinyl windows and vinyl siding, and circuit breaker electrical service are upgrades we have here! Especially appealing is the expansive yard, over a quarter of an acre, plantings with landscape brick for yard beauty, blacktop driveway and the 2 car garage which is divided into car storage, mower storage and an additional bay used as a picnic room/sunroom. Decent taxes as well, a few thousand less than others in size and location comparison! Rare does a home come up for sale on this lovely little street in the heart of the Village. Great layout, great room count and great area! A great choice!!
